backlog.spec: Replace Morgan bits with all RDKit Descriptors.CalcMolDescriptors values (about 210) computed per molecule. Replace NaN/inf with 0, clip to +-1e6, and fit the RF on them. Keep the other RF settings.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors + RF

backlog.spec: Concatenate RDKit 2D descriptors with Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 1024 bits, GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy). Fit the RF with max_features=0.3 on the combined matrix. Clean NaN/inf in the descriptors.
backlog.title: Descriptors plus count Morgan concat

backlog.spec: Use GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy in featurize instead of binary bits. Keep the RF unchanged.
backlog.title: Morgan counts instead of bits

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with LGBMRegressor (n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.5, min_child_samples=10, reg_lambda=5, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8). Train it on the RDKit 2D descriptors with NaN/inf cleaned.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostRegressor (iterations=800, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0). Train it on the RDKit descriptors concatenated with 512-bit Morgan counts.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=-1) on the cleaned RDKit descriptors.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees on descriptors

backlog.spec: Convert train_y to normalized ranks in (0,1) with scipy.stats.rankdata before fitting. This directly targets Spearman and reduces the influence of outliers. Predict as before.
backlog.title: Rank-transform target

backlog.spec: Set MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=3 and N_TREES=500. The data is noisy, so smoother trees may generalize better to new scaffolds.
backlog.title: Larger min_samples_leaf

backlog.spec: Fit three models on descriptors+counts: an RF, an LGBM and an SVR with RBF kernel on standardized features. Average the rank-normalized predictions of the three.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + LGBM + SVR ranks

backlog.spec: Compute a Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits) between all pairs. Fit SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=5, epsilon=0.1) on it and predict with the test-train kernel.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVR

backlog.spec: Use KernelRidge(kernel='precomputed', alpha=0.5) on the min-max (count Tanimoto) kernel of Morgan counts at radius 3. Standardize y first by subtracting its mean.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge Tanimoto

backlog.spec: Implement GP regression manually with a Tanimoto kernel: K+noise*I with noise=0.3, solve with scipy cho_solve, predict the mean after centering y. Use Morgan count fingerprints.
backlog.title: Gaussian process Tanimoto

backlog.spec: Concatenate MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) with the Morgan bits and the RDKit descriptors. Use the RF with max_features=0.3.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys

backlog.spec: Add hashed count fingerprints from GetAtomPairGenerator and GetTopologicalTorsionGenerator (1024 bits each) to the Morgan features. Fit the RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion counts

backlog.spec: Drop fingerprint columns that are on in fewer than 10 training molecules (using the training set only). Then fit the RF on the remaining columns plus descriptors.
backlog.title: Feature-selection by variance

backlog.spec: Standardize train_y, then fit on it with a robust clip to +-3 sd to limit outlier influence. Predictions stay on that scale.
backlog.title: Log-transform target

backlog.spec: Change MAX_FEATURES to 'sqrt' with N_TREES=600 on Morgan counts. Less correlated trees may help in high-dimensional sparse data.
backlog.title: RF max_features sqrt

backlog.spec: Use XGBRegressor(n_estimators=600, learning_rate=0.03, max_depth=4, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.4, min_child_weight=3, reg_lambda=5, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) on the cleaned RDKit descriptors plus MACCS keys.
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Average predictions of 5 LGBM models with different seeds (seed+i) and subsample 0.7 on descriptors. This reduces variance.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged multi-model average

backlog.spec: Use Morgan count fingerprints with radius 3 and 4096 bits, with useChirality off. Fit the RF with max_features=0.2.
backlog.title: Fingerprint radius 3 with feature counts

backlog.spec: Build a small feature set: MolLogP, MolMR, TPSA, MolWt, HBD, HBA, rotatable bonds, aromatic rings, fraction sp3, charge counts and ring counts, plus Morgan counts at 1024 bits. Fit the RF. This tests a compact, physchem-driven set.
backlog.title: Descriptor subset: Crippen, TPSA, logP-focused

backlog.spec: Produce out-of-fold predictions inside fit_predict (5-fold KFold, seeded) for RF, LGBM and SVR on the descriptors. Fit a non-negative LinearRegression on them to get the blending weights. Refit the models on all the data and predict.
backlog.title: Stacking RF/LGBM/SVR with ridge

backlog.spec: Use LGBM with 2000 trees and learning_rate=0.02. Hold out 15% of training molecules grouped by Murcko scaffold to pick the best iteration, then refit on all with that count. Use descriptors as features.
backlog.title: Scaffold-grouped inner early stopping

backlog.spec: Use sklearn MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(256,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, random_state=seed) on QuantileTransformer-normalized descriptors. Average 5 seeds.
backlog.title: MLP on standardized descriptors

backlog.spec: Apply QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') to the descriptors. Fit SVR(C=1, epsilon=0.1, gamma='scale') on them, with y standardized.
backlog.title: Quantile-transformed descriptors for SVR

backlog.spec: Add a Morgan FCFP-style generator (GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen) with radius 2, 1024-bit counts, concatenated with the standard ECFP counts. Fit the RF.
backlog.title: Extended connectivity with feature invariants

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, standardize each molecule: keep the largest fragment with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser, and neutralize charges with Uncharger. Then compute Morgan features as before.
backlog.title: Remove salts, keep the largest fragment

backlog.spec: Give each training molecule the weight 1/sqrt(size of its Murcko scaffold group). Pass it as sample_weight to RF.fit. This reduces the dominance of large series.
backlog.title: Sample weighting by duplicate scaffold

backlog.spec: Set bootstrap=True, max_samples=0.6 and N_TREES=800, with min_samples_leaf=2. This decorrelates the trees and regularizes.
backlog.title: RF with max_samples subsampling

backlog.spec: Fit an RF on Morgan counts and an LGBM on the RDKit descriptors. Return 0.5*rank(rf)+0.5*rank(lgbm), where the ranks are computed over the test predictions via scipy.stats.rankdata.
backlog.title: Rank-average RF(counts) and LGBM(descriptors)

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, replace y with its normalized rank (scipy rankdata(y)/len(y), optionally mapped through norm.ppf) before fitting both the RF and LightGBM. The metric is Spearman so this removes outlier influence. Keep the rank-average of predictions unchanged.
backlog.title: Rank-transform target

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, parse the molecule and keep only the largest fragment via rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags(m, asMols=True) choosing the one with most heavy atoms. Optionally neutralize charges with rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize.rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Strip salts, keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Add count fingerprints from rdFingerprintGenerator.GetAtomPairGenerator(fpSize=1024) and GetTopologicalTorsionGenerator(fpSize=1024) via GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy, and concatenate them to the Morgan counts used by the RF member (the descriptors stay for LightGBM only). Keep the rank-average.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion counts for RF

backlog.spec: Add CatBoostRegressor(iterations=800, depth=6, learning_rate=0.03, l2_leaf_reg=5, rsm=0.5, random_seed=seed, verbose=0, thread_count=8) fit on descriptors, and rank-average it with the RF and LightGBM members with equal weights (1/3 each).
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors as third member

backlog.spec: Replace RandomForestRegressor with ExtraTreesRegressor (n_estimators=500, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=-1, random_state=seed) fit on the Morgan count block. Keep LightGBM on descriptors and the rank-average.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees on descriptors+counts replacing RF

backlog.spec: Add a third member: QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') on descriptors (drop zero-variance columns), then average of 5 sklearn MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(256,64), alpha=1e-1, early_stopping=True, max_iter=300, random_state=seed+i). Rank-average with RF and LightGBM equally.
backlog.title: MLP ensemble on quantile-transformed descriptors

backlog.spec: Change the LightGBM member to num_leaves=7, min_child_samples=20, reg_lambda=10, colsample_bytree=0.3, n_estimators=800, learning_rate=0.02, plus extra_trees=True. Nothing else changes.
backlog.title: Stronger LightGBM regularization

backlog.spec: Add a third member: sklearn SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=1.0, epsilon=0.1) using a min-max Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count vectors (computed with numpy: sum of minimums / sum of maximums, vectorized in chunks). Rank-average with RF and LightGBM equally.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVR member

backlog.spec: Replace the single LightGBM with an average of 5 LightGBM models with different seeds (seed+i), each with colsample_bytree=0.3 and subsample=0.7, fit on descriptors plus the Morgan counts. Average the predictions, then rank-average with the RF.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged LightGBM with feature subsampling

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, compute out-of-fold predictions for RF, LightGBM and a Tanimoto kernel ridge using GroupKFold(5) with Murcko scaffold groups on the training set. Fit a non-negative ridge (LinearRegression(positive=True)) on the OOF ranks to get weights, refit each base on all training data, and combine the test ranks with those weights.
backlog.title: Stacking via inner scaffold-grouped OOF with ridge

incumbent.description: Add an RBF SVR (C=1, epsilon=0.1, gamma='scale') on normal-quantile-transformed descriptors with standardized y as a third rank-averaged member.

memo:
Helped: richer features and model diversity. RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts in the RF cut loss from ~0.6103 to 0.5538 (slot 0). Rank-averaging RF with LightGBM gave 0.5292 (slot 4). Adding an RBF SVR on normal-quantile-transformed descriptors gave the incumbent 0.5057 (slot 15, one run only). That is the biggest recent gain, -0.0235.

Did not help: XGBoost on descriptors plus MACCS (0.5519), RF max_features 'sqrt' with 600 trees (0.5656), MACCS in the RF (0.5612), RF on descriptors alone (0.5543). Within noise (sd ~0.0070): CatBoost added (0.5059), stacking (0.5237), stronger LightGBM regularization (0.5258), FCFP counts (0.5215/0.5185), Tanimoto kernel ridge (0.5305).

Next: replicate the 0.5057 incumbent first, since it has one run. Then try quantile-transformed inputs for other members, SVR tuning (C, epsilon), and kernel ridge or FCFP counts as extra members. Treat gains under ~0.01 as noise. Avoid MACCS and RF-only tweaks.
